strategy: Write and fsync the complete JSON artifact to a same-directory temporary inode, then publish it with an atomic hard link to the immutable final pathname. The link fails with FileExistsError when another process won; the loser re-reads and accepts only byte-equivalent semantic content. Add a synchronized concurrent conflicting-submission regression.
